80373.subject: Сховище iCloud заповнено
80373.body:
Вітаємо, Oleh Novosadov!

Ваше сховище iCloud заповнено. Оскільки Ви використали передбачений тарифним планом обсяг сховища, документи, контакти та дані з пристроїв більше не архівуються в iCloud, а фото й відео не закачуються у Фото iCloud. iCloud Drive та програми з підтримкою iCloud не оновлюються на Ваших пристроях.

Щоб і надалі користуватися цими службами iCloud, потрібно оновити план до iCloud+: https://setup.icloud.com/email/prefs/storage?path=STORAGE_AND_BACKUP/CHANGE_STORAGE_PLAN або звільнити місце в сховищі.


Оновіть план до iCloud+ з 2 ТБ за 9,99 € на міс.: https://setup.icloud.com/email/prefs/storage?path=STORAGE_AND_BACKUP/CHANGE_STORAGE_PLAN

80368.subject: Kalshi Lists a US Stock Index Perpetual Future
80368.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Kalshi](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/kalshi-launches-us-500-perpetual-future-with-no-expiration)**[ listed a US 500 perp with 15.3x leverage](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/kalshi-launches-us-500-perpetual-future-with-no-expiration)

* **[Abstract](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/abstract-to-shut-down-ethereum-layer-2-on-dec-15)**[ will shut down its Layer 2 on Dec. 15](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/abstract-to-shut-down-ethereum-layer-2-on-dec-15)

* **[Agora](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/agora-s-occ-approval-sets-up-ausd-move-to-a-us-trust-bank)**[ won conditional OCC approval for an AUSD trust bank](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/agora-s-occ-approval-sets-up-ausd-move-to-a-us-trust-bank)

* **[Arbitrum](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/arbitrum-adopts-paxos-usdg-as-its-ecosystem-dollar)**[ made Paxos' USDG its ecosystem dollar](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/arbitrum-adopts-paxos-usdg-as-its-ecosystem-dollar)

* **[Glamsterdam](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/ethereum-s-glamsterdam-upgrade-activates-on-sepolia)**[ activated on Ethereum's Sepolia testnet](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/ethereum-s-glamsterdam-upgrade-activates-on-sepolia)

A year ago Kalshi listed elections, weather and sports. On Tuesday it listed a perpetual future on 500 U.S. stocks with 15.3 times leverage. About $1.66 million traded by 10 p.m. ET.

**Kalshi** [calls the contract the US 500](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/kalshi-launches-us-500-perpetual-future-with-no-expiration). It is cash-settled, tracks the MerQube US Large Cap Index, pays funding daily and never expires. Two other firms moved the same day. **Coinbase** [turned on 15-minute and hourly crypto price markets](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/coinbase-launches-15-minute-and-hourly-crypto-price-markets) in every state except Nevada, and its help pages say Kalshi runs them. **Bloomberg** [added 24/7 Hyperliquid perpetual prices to the Terminal](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/bloomberg-terminal-adds-24-7-hyperliquid-perpetuals-pricing).

The sequence that led here started in May. The CFTC approved Kalshi's bitcoin perpetual as a futures contract on May 29. CME sued in June and argued that a contract with funding payments and no delivery date is a swap, which follows different rules. In September, Polymarket launched 20x perps on its international site. Coinbase [asked the CFTC for single-stock perpetuals](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/coinbase-seeks-cftc-approval-for-us-single-stock-perpetual-futures). Robinhood [turned on crypto perps for U.S. traders](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/robinhood-begins-us-crypto-perps-rollout-with-up-to-10x-leverage) at up to 10x through Bitstamp.
